title: Identity Is More Than Recall: A Benchmark for Persistent Identity in Deployed AI Agents
abstract: arXiv:2609.13637v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Persistent agents need evaluations that distinguish identity facts they can recall from those they express and enact. We introduce PAI-Bench, a provider-neutral benchmark for fidelity to a versioned, update-governed identity contract. It separates recall, composition, behavioral enactment, resistance, persistence, lineage, and role-conditioned updates while keeping scoring oracles outside the target process. Two frozen campaigns cover sixteen synthetic profiles, thirty-two probes, and three independently initialized target configurations, yielding 1,536 retained responses. A judge-independent literal audit finds direct-parent identifiers in 48/48 atomic responses but only 1/48 implicit self-portraits. On eight profiles, explicit field cues increase joint presence of three identity identifiers from 0/8 to 7/8 under the same four-sentence instruction. translated_title: 身份不仅仅是回忆：面向部署式AI智能体持久身份的基准测试
translated_abstract: 持久化智能体需要能够区分“可回忆的身份事实”与“实际表达和执行的身份事实”的评估方法。我们提出了PAI-Bench，这是一个提供商中立的基准，用于评估对版本化、更新受控的身份契约的忠实度。该基准将回忆、组合、行为执行、抵抗性、持久性、谱系以及角色条件更新分离开来，同时将评分判定机制保持在目标进程之外。两个冻结的评估活动涵盖十六个合成档案、三十二个探针和三个独立初始化的目标配置，共产生1,536条保留响应。一项独立于裁判的字面审计发现，直接父级标识符出现在全部48个原子响应中（48/48），但隐式自我画像仅出现在1/48的响应中。在八个档案上，在相同的四句话指令下，显式字段提示将三个身份标识符的共同出现率从0/8提升至7/8。另一项独立的启动时主体标签替换实验将完整称谓的出现率从1/8……
tldr: 该论文提出PAI-Bench基准，首次系统区分了AI智能体“能回忆的身份事实”与“能实际表达和执行的身份”，并发现智能体虽能准确召回身份信息，却极少在响应中自发表达身份。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces PAI-Bench, a provider-neutral benchmark that distinguishes identity recall from identity expression and enactment in deployed AI agents, revealing that while agents can accurately recall identity facts, they rarely express them spontaneously in their responses.
